old_description: Teton Metal Fabrication is your trusted partner for structural steel, welding, and custom fabrication in Southeast Idaho and Western Wyoming. Our AWS-certified team brings 25+ years of combined experience, delivering precise, durable work for both commercial and residential projects. As a licensed, insured, and locally owned company, we handle every job from start to finish with professionalism and care.
about:
Teton Metal Fabrication, LLC was founded in 2020 in Rexburg, Idaho, as a locally owned welding and fabrication shop. The company serves Southeast Idaho and Western Wyoming from its base in Rexburg.

The shop provides structural steel fabrication, custom metal fabrication, CNC plasma cutting, welding, installation, and repair services for commercial, residential, and agricultural clients. Its AWS-certified welders handle projects from design through installation, with capabilities including custom railings, stairs, commercial builds, equipment repairs, and decorative metalwork for homes.

Teton Metal Fabrication serves residential homeowners, commercial contractors, agricultural operators, and public works agencies across Southeast Idaho and Western Wyoming, with completed projects in cities such as Idaho Falls, Rexburg, Jackson, Driggs, and Pocatello, as well as surrounding areas.

The company emphasizes start-to-finish project management, AWS-certified welding quality, custom solutions tailored to exact needs, clear communication, and reliable timelines, aiming to deliver durable metalwork without the hassle of coordinating multiple contractors. It operates as a licensed Idaho contractor and public works contractor.

about:
Texas Injection Molding LLC was founded in 2013 in Houston, Texas, as a contract manufacturer of custom plastic injection molded parts. The company operates from a 90,000-square-foot facility near Interstate 45 and Beltway 8.

The plant houses more than 30 injection molding machines ranging from 55 to 1,350 tons, supported by a full-service tool shop for mold repair and maintenance. Services span design for manufacturability, mold design and tooling, plastic injection molding, blow molding, overmolding, assembly, decoration, custom nylon fabrication, HDPE molding, large-part molding, and warehouse logistics. The workforce numbers between 101 and 250 employees.

The company serves customers in the United States, Canada, and Mexico across industries including construction and building systems, data center hardware, energy and oil, food and beverage, industrial, medical and pharmaceutical, defense, and consumer products.

name: Texas Mesquite Co
old_description: is owned and operated by Craig Lagerstrom. Craig has been building custom furniture since 1989 and at his new location since 1999. Every piece of furniture is made with the highest quality materials available, and an eye for detail sets their furniture apart. In today's throwaway world, it's nice to know you can still find true craftsmanship.
about:
Texas Mesquite Co. operates from a showroom and workshop in Bertram, Texas, about 45 miles northwest of Austin. The company was founded in 1989 by Craig Lagerstrom, who began building custom mesquite furniture that year and moved to the current location in 1999. Lagerstrom remains the sole owner and operator, and is a member of the Texas Mesquite Association.

The shop produces hand-crafted solid mesquite furniture for homes and offices, including dining tables, coffee tables, beds, nightstands, entertainment centers, case goods, and specialty items such as fireplace mantles and lamps. Each piece starts with mesquite lumber hand-selected at the sawmill; reclaimed antique wood from pre‑1940s structures is also incorporated. Traditional joinery and hand‑carving are used throughout, and select pieces feature turquoise inlay or walnut accents. The company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual volume.

Texas Mesquite Co. serves residential and commercial clients seeking custom western, rustic, or contemporary designs. Its work has been featured in national publications such as Cowboys & Indians, Texas Highways, and Veranda. Customers order directly through the Bertram showroom or via the company website for custom commissions.

The firm emphasizes heirloom‑quality construction meant to last generations, positioning its furniture as an investment rather than a disposable good. Lagerstrom’s personal involvement in every build and the use of hand‑picked, locally sourced mesquite are cited as key differentiators.

name: Textiles Coated International
old_description: TCI produces fabrics for a variety of industries including architectural/greenhouse films, composite process materials, removable insulation jacket materials, tank liners, secondary containment, radome covers, floating roof seal materials, PTFE flexible ducting, and PTFE food belting. TCI is the world’s leading manufacturer of high-performance PTFE materials for non-metallic expansion joint manufacturers. Our superior material quality allows manufacturers to engineer successful long-term solutions for fabric expansion joints, while TCI helps our customers to remain on the forefront of new technologies for non-metallic expansion joints.
about:
Textiles Coated International (TCI) operates from Londonderry, New Hampshire, where it has manufactured high-performance fluoropolymer films, laminates, and composites since 1985. The company runs a 180,000-square-foot facility staffed by roughly 300 employees working around the clock.

TCI’s core processes include coating, lamination, fabrication, film casting, mixing, and in-house research and development supported by a dedicated laboratory. Its product line centers on proprietary all-PTFE CrossFilm™, alongside cast PTFE films, PFA, FEP, ETFE, PVDF, and ECTFE films, and PTFE-coated fiberglass fabrics. These materials are converted into ducting, belting, insulation covers, expansion-joint fabrics, and other components either by TCI or its customers.

The company serves architectural and greenhouse film producers, composite processors, removable-insulation-jacket fabricators, tank-liner and secondary-containment suppliers, radome-cover makers, floating-roof-seal manufacturers, and non-metallic expansion-joint builders. End markets include aerospace, chemical processing, electronics, energy, food processing, industrial, and medical/pharmaceutical sectors. TCI also supplied critical raw material for COVID-19 vaccine packaging under Operation Warp Speed.

TCI differentiates itself as the sole supplier offering the full range of PFA, FEP, ETFE, PVDF, ECTFE, cast PTFE, and 100% PTFE CrossFilm™. The CrossFilm™ barrier material provides unlimited shelf life, chemical and UV resistance, dynamic temperature stability, weatherability, and heat-sealability. The company holds multiple patents and awards, emphasizing long-term solutions, reliable supply, and custom engineering for applications where material failure is unacceptable.

name: That Solar Company LLC
old_description: Bud Pierce has been a part of the Energy Industry since 2005. Since the founding of That Solar Company, we’ve provided families with the opportunity to save the planet, save money, and have a reliable and renewable energy source. You’ve even got the option to be covered by a
about:
That Solar Company LLC was founded in 2005 by Bud Pierce in Springfield, Missouri. Pierce had been active in the energy industry since 2005 and established the company to provide families with renewable energy options.

The company installs residential solar photovoltaic systems and whole-home backup power solutions, notably FranklinWH battery storage systems. It also provides ongoing service and repair for existing solar arrays, specializing in "orphaned" systems originally installed by defunct contractors such as Shine Solar, Sun Valley Renewables, and SunPro/ADT Solar. The firm coordinates no-money-down financing through multiple lenders and offers 24/7 production monitoring for installed systems.

That Solar Company serves homeowners in Missouri seeking to reduce grid reliance and lower electricity bills. Its customer base includes both new solar adopters and owners of legacy systems left without support when their original installers ceased operations. The company also works with referral partners who earn a $1,000 bonus when a referred project receives permission to operate.

The company distinguishes itself through a lifetime warranty valid for as long as the homeowner owns the property, a no-pressure sales process that provides custom estimates without a sales call, and a mission to educate customers on renewable energy options. Its founders positioned the business as an educator first, aiming to put the power of choice in customers' hands.

about:
The Airtex Group was founded in 1918 in Minneapolis, Minnesota, as an agricultural textile manufacturer. Over more than a century, the company has evolved into a cut-and-sew specialist serving a global customer base from its headquarters NE. The business remains privately held, though specific ownership structure is not publicly disclosed.

Today the firm designs, develops, and manufactures custom sewn textile products, handling processes that include cutting, sewing, filling, printing, and weaving. It operates both domestic production in the United States and coordinates offshore manufacturing partners, and reports having produced more than one billion units since inception. The facility NE houses design, prototyping, and production under one roof.

The company’s customer base spans home décor, bedding, consumer bags, pillows, soft seating, OEM components, and window treatments. Long-term relationships are common, with many clients remaining for decades, and the firm emphasizes collaborative partnerships to meet project goals.

Airtex emphasizes its 100-year legacy of in-house design and strict quality control, offering end-to-end services from initial concept through final delivery, and highlights the flexibility of domestic and offshore options to meet project requirements. The company states its unwavering dedication to quality and craftsmanship as a core differentiator.

name: The Cable Guy
old_description: We understand the dynamic nature of modern technology and how it impacts your business. The Cable Guy specializes in providing tier one installation and solutions aimed at meeting enterprise level needs of any sized business or home.
about:
The Cable Guy was founded in 2006 in Scottsdale, Arizona, as a technology integration firm focused on structured cabling and low-voltage systems. The company operates as a privately held business, though ownership details such as family or veteran status are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides end-to-end installation services including structured copper and fiber optic cabling, security and surveillance systems, home and building automation, audio-visual integration, business telephone systems, overhead paging, and CATV distribution. Its technicians hold Certified Fiber Optic Technician (CFOT) credentials, and the company manages projects from design and material procurement through installation, testing, and ongoing maintenance.

The Cable Guy serves commercial, hospitality, education, public safety, healthcare, and residential clients, offering scalable solutions for businesses of any size as well as private homes. Its project portfolio includes office buildings, hotels, schools, government facilities, and medical offices.

The company emphasizes single-source accountability for procurement, scheduling, and budget control, and states that it partners only with equipment manufacturers to avoid the long-term issues caused by substandard materials. This approach stems from over two decades of combined industry experience among its leadership.

name: The Cotton Mafia
old_description: We have been the go-to source for Custom Merch, Shirts & Apparel, and Stickers for bands, brands, businesses, conventions and special events in the Las Vegas area since 2017. We specialize in bulk order & wholesale screen printing and sticker/label manufacturing to give you the lowest cost and highest returns on your investment.
about:
The Cotton Mafia is a locally owned and operated screen printing company based in Las Vegas, Nevada. Founded in 2017 by a couple of participants in the local music and arts scene, the business began as an effort to provide affordable custom merchandise to struggling artists. The company is employee-owned.

The shop specializes in bulk and wholesale screen printing as well as vinyl sticker and label manufacturing. Its capabilities include custom screen printing on apparel such as t-shirts, sweatshirts, polos, hoodies, tank tops, and ladies' styles, plus die-cut vinyl stickers, equipment labels, and printed merchandise like skateboards, tote bags, bottle coozies, and record player slip mats. The facility operates a warehouse for wholesale clients who ship garments for print-only contract work, and the company maintains a 7- to 10-business-day completion window for standard orders.

The Cotton Mafia serves bands, brands, businesses, conventions, and special events in the Las Vegas area. Wholesale accounts with apparel distributors are also a core customer segment, allowing those clients to send garments directly for printing.

The founders started the company to help local artists who could not afford high prices for locally printed merch, aiming to deliver the lowest cost and highest return on investment. The employee-owned structure is highlighted as a differentiator, with the team emphasizing hands-on customer service and quick turnaround to keep client deadlines on track.

name: The Flying Cow Shirt Company
old_description: Established in 1973 as “Greek World,” the company initially served the vibrant Greek life at the University of Missouri. This period was characterized by a deep understanding of the specific needs of sororities and fraternities, who often required custom apparel for events, philanthropies, and chapter unity. This specialized focus allowed "Greek World" to build strong relationships and a reputation for quality within this particular demographic. As the company matured, its client base naturally diversified. Local businesses seeking branded merchandise, schools ordering uniforms or spirit wear, and various other organizations requiring custom printed items began to represent a significant portion of their custom apparel orders. Recognizing this expanding market opportunity, it was decided a change was needed.
about:
The Flying Cow Shirt Company operates from Columbia, Missouri, tracing its roots to 1973 when it opened as Greek World to serve the University of Missouri’s sorority and fraternity community. The business rebranded in 1996, adopting a whimsical name chosen to reflect a broadening client base beyond Greek life.

The company produces custom printed apparel for orders ranging from single shirts to large corporate batches. While specific equipment and facility details are not disclosed, the operation handles design conception through final production for clients across the region.

Its customer base includes university Greek organizations, local businesses seeking branded merchandise, schools ordering uniforms and spirit wear, and corporations running promotional campaigns. Student groups and large corporations alike are cited as typical clients.

The firm’s stated mission — “Getting Customers What They Want, When They Want It” — emphasizes clear communication, creative collaboration, and efficient fulfillment. Leadership attributes nearly five decades of continuity in Columbia to that service philosophy rather than to any single technology or certification.
